featured_reviews.review_text:
I completed my graduation from this college between 2021 and 2023. During my time here, I observed that the staff and teaching staff lacked professionalism .They would say anything to students without any consideration. The rules and regulations were very strict, but ironically, there was no discipline.

When I finished my bachelor's degree, I visited the college to collect my mark sheet and results. I went to the office and asked the staff what documents I needed to submit to get my mark sheet. They asked me to bring my 5th-semester mark sheet.

The next day, I went back to the college, and the staff told me to clear any pending fees or issues from the office or library before they could give me my mark sheet. I did as they asked, but they kept asking me for more documents, including stamps.

Finally, they told me that my f.y. b.com fees were pending, which was not possible since I had always paid my fees on time. I showed them the receipts, but they refused to believe me. They demanded that I pay the fees again, which I didn't owe.

It was frustrating and disappointing to see how they handled the situation. They seemed more interested in getting the money than in helping me. For them, ₹4640 might not be a big amount, but for me, as a middle-class student, it mattered a lot. If i didn't have fees receipt i would have been forced to pay the fees otherwise they are not giving me Marksheet.  i informed that to my class teacher and principal about this issue , but they didn't respond or take any action .

This experience left a bad impression on me about the college's administration and their priorities.

featured_reviews.review_text:
My college has always stood out because of its strong infrastructure and well-planned campus environment. From spacious classrooms to well-equipped labs, everything is designed to make the learning experience smooth and productive. The campus atmosphere is clean, disciplined, and student-friendly. You genuinely feel like you're part of a professional and growing institution the moment you step inside.

Being from the Computer Science department, I had a very positive academic journey. The department is known for its dedicated faculty, supportive staff, and the practical exposure it provides to students. Teachers are approachable and always ready to help, whether it’s about assignments, projects, or career guidance. Other departments also maintain the same level of discipline and commitment, which reflects the overall quality of the college.

One thing I really appreciate about the college is the variety of events and activities it organizes throughout the year. Large festivals, technical events, cultural programs, and guest sessions with well-known personalities make the environment lively and inspiring. These events don’t just entertain students—they help us grow, network, and learn beyond the syllabus. The placement opportunities provided are also helpful for students who want to start their career right after graduation.

If there is one challenge, it is the college’s distance from the nearest station. Traveling daily can be tiring for many students because of the long commute. The canteen also has scope for improvement. But apart from these minor issues, the overall experience is truly valuable. The college has given me strong academic knowledge, great memories, and a sense of confidence for the future. I genuinely believe it’s a great place for students who want quality education and a supportive environment.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Greetings to everyone reading this. This is not intended to be a formal review, but rather a reflection of my personal experience, which I felt was important to share.

For students whose primary goal is to receive a strong, in-depth academic education, this institution may not fully meet those expectations, particularly within the IT department. While there are a few faculty members with solid subject knowledge, much of the teaching follows a traditional, textbook-focused approach.

As a result, students seeking a high-quality or industry-oriented learning experience may need to rely significantly on self-study and external resources to achieve their goals. Additionally, placement support for IT students is limited, and students may need to pursue job opportunities independently.

Regards,
Akmal Monye
